# Project instructions

This workspace contains PeopleFirst, an employee management coursework project.

- Stack: vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Node.js with Express, and persistent SQLite via sql.js (WebAssembly).
- Keep the REST API under `/api/employees`; serve the frontend from `public/`.
- Validate and normalize all incoming employee data on the server. Use prepared statements for SQL.
- Keep the interface responsive, accessible, and dependency-light.
- Run the app with `npm run dev` during development or `npm start` for a normal run.
